Travel Cambodia Without Connectivity Worries

Cambodia's crown jewel, Angkor Wat, is one of humanity's greatest architectural achievements – and you'll want a reliable connection to navigate the vast temple complex, translate Khmer script, and share your sunrise photos instantly. Sim2Me's eSIM for Cambodia delivers exactly that.

Why Choose Sim2Me?

  • Coverage on Smart (Axiata) Cambodia and Cellcard.
  • 4G LTE in Phnom Penh and Siem Reap.
  • Activate before your flight – no SIM card hunting at Phnom Penh airport.
  • Simple QR-based setup.

Network Performance in Cambodia

4G LTE in Phnom Penh, Siem Reap, and Sihanoukville. 3G along National Roads 1 and 6. The Angkor Wat complex itself has surprisingly good 4G coverage.
